text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival.
A major event where fans are welcomed to Tracen Academy so everyone can have fun together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was also a precious chance to let Neo Universe unwind before the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sport Neo Universe decided to participate in was—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe is going to demo "bowling."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "THIS"... is my favorite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was brought out was,
surprisingly enough, an Earth-shaped bowling ball.
choice_data_list: Is that what you call "THIS"?
Is that what you call "THIS"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Unknown. That's all she said.
The Umamusume who lent it to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing before Neo Universe, a complete bowling novice,
were her rivals...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do our best, Baku-chan, Chiyo-chan!
When it comes to bowling, we're the best♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right! I used to do that all the time when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right by the Victory Club where all the Sakura kids gathered,
there were two bowling alleys!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san, please don't get too fired up
and throw your ball into the next lane again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her opponents were the three Sakura girls:
Sakura Laurel, Sakura Bakushin O, and Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Neo Universe wishes to learn the throwing method."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"What needs to be done... is to throw in the Earth
and 'trigger' a gravitational collapse, yes."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Still, the "launch method" is—"unknown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she doesn't know the proper form.
Though it's just on the spot, I teach her how to throw, and then...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"—I get it now. It's like purging
the moisture pooled in the palms of your hands..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe finished throwing the ball.
Then, she smoothly averted her gaze from the lane where the ball rolled.
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Aren't you going to watch?
What's wrong? Aren't you going to watch?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The black hole's interference is...
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe does not want to see.
The end of the Earth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *Clunk.*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ball veered wildly from the center...
and was swallowed by the gutter on the side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the bowling tournament came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text: The winner is Team Victory Club!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Children of the Sakura star...
Neo Universe offers... 'Congratulations.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Watching my own bad pitches... is unbearable, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I totally get it...
When you make a mistake,
you just end up feeling so down, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Really!? But I actually love that rattlety-clatter sound!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Baku-chan is special.
I suppose I'll watch her through to the end while feeling jealous.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe understands the "cause of defeat."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's because "THIS" was too small.
Next time, a giant gas planet...
choice_data_list: A Jupiter Ball is probably against the rules, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You must not change the size of the ball.
Neo Universe looked disappointed by her defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home that day... the two of us held a review session.
Mainly about what to do after throwing a wild pitch.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Neo Universe couldn't make everyone feel 'entertained'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I needed two hours of training every single day...
Just to master it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was frustrated that she couldn't
put on a great show for her fans, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Neo Universe!
That was so entertaining!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was super cute!
Throwing the Earth really gives you a unique character trait!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The characters are... "STDA"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, everyone is "cheering"... for what they find "entertaining"...
choice_data_list: Ah, that was some great fan service!
Yeah, that was great fan service!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike a race, the fans didn't come here
today to watch a cutthroat competition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Neo Universe take on bowling for the first time, it seemed she genuinely had fun.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I... see. Neo Universe is relieved. To have "contributed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home that day... the two of us held a review session.
Mainly about what to do after throwing a wild pitch.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Neo Universe turned her gaze away... from the ball's trajectory."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I looked away... to keep a crater from forming in my heart. —Negative?
choice_data_list: Yeah, maybe I should've watched it.
Yeah, maybe it would've been better to see it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you turn away from your failures, you'll never learn anything.
Nor will you be able to make use of it next time.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Right... Yeah. 'Just don't look.'
That way you won't get hurt, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words Neo Universe suddenly uttered.
If you don't look... you won't get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I have to see it...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Something just brushed against my senses.
It felt like I was on the verge of understanding something very important..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, about the reason why the Neo Universe
of another universe is unseen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are several possible reasons why you can't see it.
"The lens is fogged," "it's dark,"
"it's in a blind spot," and so forth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, could there not be
one other major possibility?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Namely, those who watch—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What if "I don't actually want to see it"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Universe...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trai... ner?
choice_data_list: To be honest... you don't really want to see it, do you?
To be honest... you don't really want to see it, do you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Perceptive as always, Neo Universe seemed to realize right away
that this wasn't about bowling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right, supposing hypothetically
that they "don't want to see it"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Most likely, something very unpleasant happened after the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Something you refuse to acknowledge no matter what. Or
something you just can't bear to face directly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I could, I wouldn't want to see it.
If I could, I'd pretend it never happened."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know if she's closing her eyes
on purpose or not. But if those feelings
are what's clouding her vision..."
choice_data_list: Universe... hasn't disappeared

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: It should be right there. It always has been.
It should be right there, always.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: So...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I swallowed the words that were about to follow.
As if to carry on her feelings...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If "I" want to see it—I can.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If only Neo Universe... doesn't turn her eyes away...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She gave a small nod.
It felt as though she had grasped the core of the mystery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crack in the lens has been found.
In that case, all that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If Neo Universe just makes up her mind, she should be able to see all of another universe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What happened after the Tenno Sho (Spring), and "where" and "what" Neo Universe was doing afterward.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, but...
choice_data_list: Let's watch, Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If Neo Universe doesn't face the truth, there's no way to know how to overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how painful it was, I had to look directly at it
and increase the resolution of that other universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"That is... 'MORT'...
If it is close to 'indispensable', then..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Affir... mative.
Neo Universe will... 'observe.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The bottom of a black hole...
I don't want to look...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Beyond—the "ABSS".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)...
Neo Universe finished... 10th.
She ran out of steam, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The exam showed no abnormalities.
Setting our sights on the next Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"There weren't any strange omens either.
I didn't sense anything. More importantly—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To make up for running so poorly...
at the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't... notice.
I didn't want to notice.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't 'tell' them.
By the time they noticed, it was already...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Time flowed on. Even as the river branched, 
"you" came to see me. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
She can't run anymore. We can't run together anymore.
Because Neo Universe is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe is......

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The Neo Universe of another universe...
choice_data_list: What's wrong? What happened!?
What's wrong? What happened?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I failed to notice... her injury...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't talk about... my injury...
And since then... my ABSS has been...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hugged Neo Universe with all my might
as she returned from her time travel of sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've caused her so much pain.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I obtained the map. A sector chart marked with a more precise location of the "GATE."
